title: Protected Attributes Tell Us Who, Behavior Tells Us How: A Comparison of Demographic and Behavioral Oversampling for Fair Student Success Modeling
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating demographic bias (such as gender and socioeconomic status) in student success prediction models using oversampling techniques. It treats fairness as a statistical objective (minimizing False Negative Rate differences) rather than evaluating religion, theology, or benchmarking moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
